# Bromley - council briefing

*Auto-generated from council minutes, 18 May 2026 to 13 August 2026*

## What's dominating the agenda

Transport & Highways leads with 2,996 keyword hits, driven mainly by the Development Control Committee and Plans Sub-Committee No. 1's planning casework, closely followed by Housing & Planning (2,501, also via Development Control and the Plans Sub-Committees) and Finance & Budget (2,428, largely the Executive's budget and contract decisions).

## Notable decisions

- The Executive approved co-locating Children & Family Centre and Youth Services at the Spitfire Youth Centre, and disposing of the former Biggin Hill Children & Family Centre site for affordable housing or sale (key decision, approved, 22 Jul).
- The Portfolio Holder for Adult Care and Health approved a three-year contract for Sensory Enablement services supporting residents with hearing and vision impairments (key decision, approved, 7 Jul).
- The Executive approved re-tendering the council's insurance policies, worth an estimated £10.7m over eight years (key decision, 24 Jun).
- The Executive approved an increased capital budget for the Keston Ponds restoration project (key decision, 24 Jun).
- The Portfolio Holder for Children, Education and Families approved a contract to rebuild a two-storey classroom block at Marian Vian Primary School in Beckenham (key decision, approved, 11 Jun).
- The Portfolio Holder for Transport, Highways and Road Safety approved an increased budget for the Anerley Hill bus lane scheme (key decision, approved, 6 May).

## Worth a closer look

- External auditors presented their planning report for the year ended 31 March 2026 to the Audit and Risk Management Committee (25 Jun). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1472367/file)
- The Adult Care and Health Policy Development and Scrutiny Committee reviewed progress on the portfolio's action plan to help older and disabled residents live independently (16 Jun). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1470472/file)
- Schools Forum heard that the Children, Education and Families portfolio is projecting a £1.29m overspend this year, with SEN transport flagged as an ongoing risk (2 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1489384/file)
- The Local Pension Board reviewed the pension fund's risk register (25 Jun). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1472284/file)

## Projects on residents' radar

- **Crystal Palace National Sports Centre redevelopment** - the Development Control Committee considered planning and listed-building applications for the historic sports centre, including questions from a local resident about the scheme's design (23 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1524434/file)
- **Former Bromley Civic Centre, Stockwell Close** - the Development Control Committee reviewed plans to redevelop the council's old civic centre site on Stockwell Close (1 Jun). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1454663/file)
- **Kentwood scheme** - the Executive fast-tracked procurement of a design-and-build contractor for this housing scheme, backed by roughly £900,000 of Greater London Authority grant funding, so a contractor could be in place ahead of public engagement sessions (20 May). [source](https://cds.bromley.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=11175)
- **Wharton Road children's home** - residents pressed the council over parking arrangements for the proposed children's home on Wharton Road, after the Executive approved the scheme in 2025 (24 Jun). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1524373/file)
